findings.title: PUT path validation missing for non-integer IDs
findings.detail: int(self.path.split('/')[-1]) is called without try/except, so a non-integer path id raises ValueError instead of returning a proper error. Should validate and return 400.

findings.title: GET /books q filter logic broken
findings.detail: When field == 'q', the code does val in b[field].lower() where field is 'q', but book dicts have no 'q' key, causing a KeyError. The q filter should instead search across title/author/isbn/synopsis fields.

findings.title: Type validation missing in POST and PUT
findings.detail: Task requires 400 for 'field of wrong type', but POST and PUT only check for missing/empty required fields and id in body — they do not validate that fields are strings.

findings.title: GET /books id query param without type validation
findings.detail: int(filters['id']) is called without try/except, so a non-integer id query param raises ValueError instead of returning 400.
